description: This file is a script for analyzing source code files to find calls to 'os.tmpdir()' or similar functions, used for checking certain patterns in code related to messaging temporary directories. It imports various utility modules and defines functions to parse and analyze TypeScript source code.

methods.name: collectOsTmpdirImports
methods.description: Analyzes import declarations in a source file to identify imports from 'node:os' or 'os' modules and collect identifiers related to 'tmpdir'.

methods.name: findMessagingTmpdirCallLines
methods.description: Creates a source file object and finds all lines where 'os.tmpdir()' or similar calls are made within the provided code content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Runs the guard analysis to find and report calls to 'os.tmpdir()' or related functions within specified source roots.
